records.title: Midterm Meltdown - How US elections sparked a rethink on energy risks
records.claim: Reuters分析称，美国中期选举后，原油、柴油、油轮运费、天然气、LNG和煤炭等能源市场整体走低，市场正在重新评估中东冲突扩大风险的概率。
records.boundary: 这是Reuters评论对市场风险定价的解释，不代表地缘风险已经消失或实际供应已完全恢复。
records.support_excerpt: Since the US midterm elections, a broad range of energy-linked markets ... have moved lower together.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Midterm Meltdown - How US elections sparked a rethink on energy risks

records.title: US LNG feedgas slips as Sabine Pass demand drops, Freeport facility constrained
records.claim: Reuters援引LSEG初步数据称，美国LNG出口设施Feedgas在11月17日约为19.2 bcfd，低于前一日约19.5 bcfd。
records.boundary: LSEG初步数据，反映单日流量变化；不能直接外推为月度出口量或结构性供应能力下降。
records.support_excerpt: US natural gas flows to LNG export plants fell ... to about 19.2 billion cubic feet per day from 19.5 bcfd the previous day.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: US LNG feedgas slips as Sabine Pass demand drops, Freeport facility constrained

records.title: US LNG feedgas slips as Sabine Pass demand drops, Freeport facility constrained
records.claim: Reuters称Sabine Pass Feedgas降至约4.2 bcfd，前一日超过5.0 bcfd；Freeport约1.5 bcfd，低于通常约2.0 bcfd。
records.boundary: Reuters报道的运营推断为至少一条Sabine Pass液化列车可能停运或降负荷，但Freeport称三条列车均在运行；未确认持续性设备故障。
records.support_excerpt: Feedgas to Sabine Pass ... declined to about 4.2 bcfd ... Freeport ... remained at about 1.5 bcfd ... below its usual 2 bcfd.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: US LNG feedgas slips as Sabine Pass demand drops, Freeport facility constrained

records.title: Brazil regulator pauses Enel Sao Paulo case after majority back ending contract
records.claim: Reuters报道，Aneel五名董事中已有四名支持建议提前终止Enel圣保罗配电特许经营权，但最后一名董事要求更多时间审阅材料，表决因此暂缓。
records.boundary: 监管建议尚未形成最终决定；若建议推进，最终决定权仍属于巴西矿业和能源部。
records.support_excerpt: Four of five directors ... urged a termination of the contract ... the case was halted when the last director ... asked for more time.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Brazil regulator pauses Enel Sao Paulo case after majority back ending contract

records.title: Brazil regulator pauses Enel Sao Paulo case after majority back ending contract
records.claim: Reuters报道，Enel表示，表决延期为其提交的数据和论据提供了进一步技术评估机会。
records.boundary: 这是公司对程序延期的回应，不代表监管机构接受其论据或已改变审查方向。
records.support_excerpt: Enel Sao Paulo said the postponement ... provides another opportunity for the data and arguments presented by the company to be technically assessed.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Brazil regulator pauses Enel Sao Paulo case after majority back ending contract
